notes:
CRM notes (fragments, paraphrase):
- Lead: small ecommerce vendor building conversational commerce bot + product search.
- Primary contact: Lena Ortiz (Founder/CTO) — technical, wants to avoid storing customer prompts persistently.
- Key Qs from call: "What logs do you retain by default? How long? Can we opt-out of prompt storage or have ephemeral mode?"
- Wants simple billing (card), likely low ARR first year (proof-of-concept).
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for chat; expected concurrency ~15-25 rps at peak during promotions. Cost-sensitive — will default to hosted API if unit economics ok.
- Model preferences: open-model friendly, happy with Redwood-curated variants; want fallback to smaller quantized variant when cost/latency spike.
- Security ask: SOC2 not required immediately, but want audit logs + retention controls + SSO for admin console. Also asked about EU data residency for ~5% EU customers.
- Legal wants: (a) explicit retention window (default), (b) opt-out wording + API flag to disable storing prompts (or automatic redaction), (c) sample DPA language.
- SE notes: can propose hosted with 30-day logs default + opt-out via "store_prompts=false" flag during PoC (proposed workaround). Need to confirm persistence of KV-cache vs retained prompts.
- Quote from CTO: "We need a button to stop storing customer's message history — otherwise legal won't sign."
- Next: send two attachments (privacy FAQ + example opt-out clause), propose 30-min technical PoC on 2026-03-17.
- POC scope: integrate hosted API, test 2 model flavors (base + quantized fallback), measure p95 latency and token cost for 1k monthly active users.
- Risks: if Redwood cannot provide clear opt-out/prompt-storage control, likely to evaluate other vendors or self-host.
